design_detail: Expediente 22.113: one-off 1% on declared assets; persons over US$2.5m, companies over US$5m
quote_original: llegó el momento para que los que tienen más riqueza y acumulan más capital, se solidaricen con Costa Rica contribuyendo al país con un impuesto a los grandes capitales
quote_en: the time has come for those with the most wealth and the most accumulated capital to show solidarity with Costa Rica by contributing a tax on large capital
source_title: Nicolás presenta proyecto para gravar la riqueza a grandes capitales
grading_note: Her own words on filing the bill; one-off 1% levy on the declared assets of the wealthiest, a named bill she sponsored.

design_detail: Expediente 22.113, rejected
quote_original: gravar la riqueza acumulada a través del tiempo, por una única vez, con un impuesto del 1%
quote_en: to tax wealth accumulated over time, once only, with a 1% tax
source_title: Expediente 22113 - Impuesto solidario a la riqueza, para reactivar el país ante la emergencia del COVID-19
grading_note: Bill page lists her as the principal signatory (Firma Principal) and the text as a one-off 1% levy on accumulated wealth; status shown as rejected.

design_detail: Backs expediente 22.113 (one-off 1% on large capital)
quote_original: yo apoyo el proyecto de doña Franggi
source_title: Paola Vega: Sobre proyecto de Fanggi Nicolás, coincidimos, en que quienes más tengan aporten más
grading_note: Her own words backing a named wealth-levy bill by another deputy; her own bill is an income-tax surcharge and is not the basis.

design_detail: Expediente 21.883, art. 23: one-off 0.1% on net equity of companies above CRC 95 million
quote_original: por una única vez, de coma uno por ciento (0,1%), sobre el patrimonio de las personas jurídicas comerciales
quote_en: once only, at zero point one percent (0.1%), on the net equity of commercial legal entities
source_title: Ley de Contingencia Fiscal Progresiva y Solidaria ante la emergencia nacional del COVID-19 (expediente 21.883)
grading_note: Principal signatory of a bill whose chapter II taxes company net equity (assets minus liabilities) once; it covers legal entities only, not individuals, and sits among income surcharges.

design_detail: Expediente 21.883 (0.1% on company net equity)
quote_original: como el que también está proponiendo ahora el Frente Amplio en la Asamblea Legislativa
quote_en: like the one the Frente Amplio is now also proposing in the Legislative Assembly
source_title: Hacia el impuesto solidario
grading_note: A column says the Frente Amplio proposes a solidarity tax and lists its bill, which includes the 0.1% on company equity; party attribution comes from the column, the bill is by its deputy Villalta.

design_detail: Tax wealth to reduce inequality (OECD ministerial summit)
quote_original: Debemos tasar la riqueza como otra forma de generar mayores condiciones de igualdad
quote_en: We must tax wealth as another way of creating greater conditions of equality
source_title: Nuevos impuestos a “riqueza” para más “igualdad”, propone Carlos Alvarado ante OCDE
grading_note: The sitting president names taxing wealth, with no rate or bill; the same article says a levy on those with most capital would follow if other measures fall short.

design_detail: Tax large incomes and capital during the COVID-19 crisis
quote_original: hay grandes rentas y capitales deben ser gravadas
quote_en: there are large incomes and capital that must be taxed
source_title: PAC pide más impuestos, ahora “sobre grandes capitales”
grading_note: The party's Political Commission calls for taxing large capital but gives no design; ambiguous between wealth and capital income.

design_detail: Temporary 10% on the net worth of large personal and family fortunes and corporate wealth
quote_original: impuestos transitorios: 10% al patrimonio de grandes fortunas personales o familiares, y riqueza corporativa
quote_en: temporary taxes: 10% on the wealth of large personal or family fortunes, and corporate wealth
source_title: Organizaciones sindicales proponen medidas para enfrentar emergencia por COVID-19
grading_note: The union's own proposal with a rate (10%) on the wealth of large fortunes; temporary.

design_detail: Solidarity tax on mega-wealth
quote_original: Establecer un impuesto solidario a las megariquezas, las megafortunas, los megacapitales
quote_en: Establish a solidarity tax on mega-wealth, mega-fortunes and mega-capital
source_title: Sindicatos y otros sectores rechazan anuncio de nuevos impuestos
grading_note: One of seven alternatives ANEP gave the authorities to the IMF deal; no rate in this item.

design_detail: Create taxes on wealth
quote_original: suspender el pago de la deuda o al menos de sus intereses, o crear impuestos a la riqueza
quote_en: suspend debt payments or at least interest, or create taxes on wealth
source_title: Organizaciones sindicales proponen medidas para enfrentar emergencia por COVID-19
grading_note: The article reports that the three organisations (ANEP, BUSSCO, SITRASEP) jointly demand wealth taxes among other measures; named but not specified. Grade B on the joint statement only.

design_detail: Create taxes on wealth

grading_note: The article reports that the three organisations (ANEP, BUSSCO, SITRASEP) jointly demand wealth taxes among other measures; named but not specified. Grade B on the joint statement only.

design_detail: Proposal to tax the great fortunes
quote_original: El país requiere, al menos, de una propuesta para gravar las grandes fortunas
quote_en: The country requires, at the least, a proposal to tax the great fortunes
source_title: Tres ‘garantes éticos’ piden al Presidente gravar grandes fortunas para afrontar la crisis
grading_note: Letter to the President signed by the three ethics advisers (Duncan, Bolaños, Arroyo); it asks for a proposal to tax the great fortunes, without rate or bill.

design_detail: 1% of the equity of large firms (FIFCO, Grupo Nación, Grupo Britt)
quote_original: si le ponemos un impuesto al 1% del patrimonio de FIFCO, Grupo Nación y Grupo Britt
quote_en: if we put a tax of 1% on the equity of FIFCO, Grupo Nación and Grupo Britt
source_title: ¿Impulsar la economía del COVID-19 con dinero de los capitales y patrimonios más ricos?
grading_note: The economist's own costing of a 1% tax on the equity of named large companies; corporate rather than personal wealth, so grade B.

design_detail: Joint BUSSCO / CNE proposal: 1% on the net wealth of large taxpayers (plus 3% on profits)
quote_original: aumentar la carga tributaria, gravando el patrimonio, las herencias y las grandes fortunas o riqueza
quote_en: increase the tax burden, taxing wealth, inheritance and the great fortunes or riches
source_title: Impuestos a la riqueza y grandes fortunas en América Latina: Situación y avances recientes en la región
grading_note: Report by Latindadd (2021) quoting the BUSSCO and CNE proposal, which includes a 1% tax on the net wealth of large taxpayers and the 95th percentile of self-employed people (table 7 of the report); the original BUSSCO text and its date were not found, so the date is the report date.

design_detail: Joint BUSSCO / CNE proposal: 1% on the net wealth of large taxpayers (plus 3% on profits)

source_title: Impuestos a la riqueza y grandes fortunas en América Latina: Situación y avances recientes en la región

design_detail: Co-author of the BUSSCO / CNE proposal: 1% on net wealth of large taxpayers
quote_original: La propuesta ha sido elaborada por Jorge Coronado Marroquín y Lorenzo Ramírez Cardoza
quote_en: The proposal was drawn up by Jorge Coronado Marroquín and Lorenzo Ramírez Cardoza
source_title: Impuestos a la riqueza y grandes fortunas en América Latina: Situación y avances recientes en la región
grading_note: Footnote of the Latindadd report naming the two experts of the Comisión Nacional de Enlace who wrote the BUSSCO/CNE proposal, which includes a 1% tax on net wealth of large taxpayers. Identification of Lorenzo Ramírez Cardoza with the IIS-UCR economist is by name and field.

source_title: Impuestos a la riqueza y grandes fortunas en América Latina: Situación y avances recientes en la región

design_detail: Progressive taxes on fortunes, big capital, banks and free-trade zones
quote_original: Hay que exigir y luchar por impuestos progresivos a las fortunas, el gran capital, a las grandes empresas, los bancos, las zonas francas y los exportadores
quote_en: We must demand and fight for progressive taxes on fortunes, big capital, big companies, banks, free-trade zones and exporters
source_title: Costa Rica: Por impuestos a las grandes fortunas para que la crisis no la paguen los trabajadores
grading_note: Signed opinion piece titled for taxes on great fortunes; the call is for progressive taxes on fortunes among other targets, no rate.

design_detail: Temporary progressive income tax, possibly complemented by a general tax on wealth including financial wealth
quote_original: un impuesto generalizado sobre los patrimonios, incluidos los de tipo financiero
quote_en: a general tax on wealth, including financial wealth
source_title: Aporte del Grupo Economía Pluralista a la convocatoria Costa Rica escucha, propone y dialoga
grading_note: Letter to the government signed by the group; the wealth tax is something the income tax "could be complemented with", no rate.

design_detail: Annual tax on net personal wealth: exempt to CRC 150 million, then 0.5% rising to 2.0% above CRC 10,000 million
quote_original: este impuesto se aplicaría sobre el patrimonio neto una vez deducidos los posibles pasivos o deudas que la persona pudiera tener
quote_en: this tax would apply to net wealth after deducting the person's possible liabilities or debts
source_title: Hacia una reforma tributaria progresiva: contexto, criterios guía y contenidos fundamentales. Un paso necesario hacia una Costa Rica posneoliberal
grading_note: Single-author paper that proposes the tax with a rate scale and threshold (signed February 2025, approved July 2025).

design_detail: Signer of the Grupo Economía Pluralista letter
source_title: Aporte del Grupo Economía Pluralista a la convocatoria Costa Rica escucha, propone y dialoga
grading_note: Name as printed in the signature block of the group letter that names a general tax on wealth.
